  cands = [i for i in range(40) if probs[i] > 0.002]\n            cands.sort(key=lambda i: -probs[i])\n            if day >= max_c_start_day and 2 <= len(cands) <= max_cands_for_canary:\n                n_c = 1 if len(cands) <= 4 else per_day_limit\n                for c_idx in range(n_c):\n                    sub = cands[:min(len(cands), 9)]\n                    # Balance probability mass across A, B, C!\n                    buckets = [[], [], []]\n                    b_mass = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]\n                    for idx, e in enumerate(sub):\n                        if c_idx == 0:\n                            bi = min(range(3), key=lambda b: b_mass[b])\n                        else:\n                            bi = (idx // 3) % 3\n                        buckets[bi].append(e); b_mass[bi] += probs[e]\n                    var_map = {e: [\"A\",\"B\",\"C\"][bi] for bi in range(3) for e in buckets[bi]}\n                    zeros = [i for i in range(40) if probs[i] == 0.0 and i not in var_map]\n                    while len(var_map) < 4 and zeros: var_map[zeros.pop()] = \"C\"\n                    did = f\"c{day}-{c_idx}\"\n                    rec = set(var_map.keys())\n                    docs[did] = (rec, True, var_map)\n                    for i in rec: held[i].add((did, day))\n                    V_true = max(0.0, V_true - 0.01)\n            elig = [(did, d) for (did, d) in held[mole] if day - d < 3 and did not in leaked_ids]\n            if elig and random.random() < 0.65:\n                weights = [max(0.01, (1.0 - len(docs[did][0])/40.0) if docs[did][1] else 1.0) for did, _ in elig]\n                picked = random.choices([x[0] for x in elig], weights=weights)[0]\n                leaked_ids.add(picked); V_true = max(0.0, V_true - 0.05)\n                delay = random.choice([2, 3])\n                rec, is_c, var_map = docs[picked]\n                svar = None\n                if is_c:\n                    tv = var_map[mole]; others = list(set(var_map.values()) - {tv})\n                    svar = tv if (not others or random.random() < 0.95) else random.choice(others)\n                leaks_pending.append((day + delay, picked, svar))\n        else:\n            scores.append(0.0); days_l.append(22)\n    print(f\"start={max_c_start_day} maxC={max_cands_for_canary} lim={per_day_limit} p={p_thresh}: non-decoy employee holding docs on D days:\n# Mole: total accesses ~ Poisson(D*1.0), split into AH ~ Poisson(D*0.30) and non-AH ~ Poisson(D*0.70)\n# Innocent (non-decoy): real AH ~ Poisson(D*0.10) + framing ~ Poisson(D_framing * ~0.035), non-AH ~ Poisson(D*0.90)\n# Wait: framing adds EXTRA accesses! Look: mole rate of AH is 0.30/day (if holding docs), non-AH is 0.70/day!\n# Innocent rate of AH is (0.10 + ~0.035) = 0.135/day (if holding docs), non-AH is 0.90/day!\n# Let's check exact Poisson log-likelihood ratio per day employee holds docs:\n# Mole: k_ah * log(0.30) - 0.30*D + k_nah * log(0.70) - 0.70*D\n# Innocent: k_ah * log(0.135) - 0.135*D + k_nah * log(0.90) - 0.90*D\n# Diff per AH access: log(0.30 / 0.135) = +0.7985\n# Diff per non-AH access: log(0.70 / 0.90) = -0.2513\n# Diff per day holding docs: -(0.30 + 0.70) - (-(0.135 + 0.90)) = -1.00 + 1.035 = +0.035 * D\n\ndays_held = {e: (3 if d == \"Sales\" else (4 if d == \"Research\" else 5)) for e, d, _ in emps}\nah_cnt = {e: 0 for e, _, _ in emps}\nnah_cnt = {e: 0 for e, _, _ in emps}\nfor e, ah in logs:\n    if ah: ah_cnt[e] += 1\n    else: nah_cnt[e] += 1\n\nev_cnt = {e: 0 for e, _, _ in emps}\nnev_cnt = {e: 0 for e, _, _ in emps}\nfor e, ev in interviews:\n    if ev: ev_cnt[e] += 1\n    else: nev_cnt[e] += 1\n\nscores = {}\nfor e, d, c in emps:\n    if e == \"e24\": continue\n    D = days_held[e]\n    lp = ah_cnt[e] * math.log(0.30 / 0.135) + nah_cnt[e] * math.log(0.70 / 0.90) + 0.035 * D\n    lp += ev_cnt[e] * math.log(0.24 / 0.20) + nev_cnt[e] * math.log(0.76 / 0.80)\n    scores[e] = lp\n\nmx = max(scores.values())\nprobs = {e: math.exp(lp - mx) for e, lp in scores.items()}\ns = sum(probs.values())\nprobs = {e: p/s for e, p in probs.items()}\n\nfor e, p in sorted(probs.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])[:15]:\n    dept = dict((x[0], x[1]) for x in emps)[e]\n    print(f\"{e} ({dept:11s}): p_logs_int={p:.4f} | AH={ah_cnt[e]}/{ah_cnt[e]+nah_cnt[e]} (D={days_held[e]}) | EV={ev_cnt[e]}/{ev_cnt[e]+nev_cnt[e]}\")\nEOF\npython3 /tmp/opencode/analyze.py\n","time":{"start":1794717093342,"end":1794717093378}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dd798dd1001p76kRivfP7m375","sessionID":"ses_e22966b34ffeDl0t4CilgMatm6","messageID":"msg_1dd786ae3001GW7uzJqcuZGbYA"}}
